name: Keyideas Ring Filter & Search
author: Keyideas Infotech Private Limited

sections.description:
Keyideas is a pioneer in jewelry solutions, offering a specialized app tailored for jewelry website owners. This innovative tool empowers WooCommerce store owners to seamlessly integrate a full-scale ring-building experience on their sites. By enhancing customer engagement and driving a substantial 30% increase in sales, this integration solidifies jewelry retailers’ leadership in online customization trends. Join the forefront of industry innovation and elevate your sales today with Keyideas!

  1. Ring Builder with lab-grown, mined, or colored diamonds and gemstones.
  2. Enrich inventory with rings and diamonds using Ring Builder, boosting sales.
  3. Boost engagement, turning visitors into loyal fans who linger on your site.
  4. Enjoy seamless integration with suppliers like Nivoda, VDB, and RapNet.
  5. Integrate more suppliers like RapNet, VDB, and others via CSV/API with ease.

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party services for certain functionality. Below are the services used:

  1. Brevo Conversations Widget (https://conversations-widget.brevo.com)

    • Purpose: Loads the JavaScript required for chat functionality.
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/

  2. YouTube (https://www.youtube.com)

    • Purpose: Embeds tutorial and informational videos in the admin interface.
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:
sections.changelog:
v1.0.0

  • Initial release

v1.0.1

  • UI and performance updates with few bug fixes.

v1.1.0

  • Theme updated and attributes mapping support added
  • Major bug fixes

v1.2.0

  • Introduced a new, more stable theme with enhanced accessibility and an improved user interface and experience (UI/UX).
  • Implemented numerous major and minor bug fixes for greater overall stability.
